She had no seizure disorder but had a left cerebral ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction 4 months ago with use of synthetic cannabis
The patient's friend reported she used synthetic cannabis just before the seizure
diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema in cortical and subcortical white matter bilaterally
urine drug screen positive for cannabinoids
The patient developed another tonic-clonic seizure, which aborted with medication
